comparison.objective: Remove and replace an air-conditioner mesh filter behind a hinged cover versus commission a compact shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Cover operation and coordinated extraction/insertion of a broad thin part behind lugs and a lip versus recessed tool use, fine collar adjustment, counterholding, and torque-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Dusty filter removed; clean filter seated within stated position/orientation tolerances; cover shut for one second versus two safe dynamic stops and retained setting.
comparison.reason: The complete current and board specs establish a thin-part replacement task, not dynamic calibration. No material rubric details are missing for this comparison.
